name: com.zen.core
description: Base for Unity games in one package: Base.dll, DataManager, UI, currency, extensions, vibration, ads (AdMob + AdZative native waterfall, UMP, ATT, AppsFlyer, Taichi, review / update, splash, debug tools), IAP (Unity IAP), Firebase (Analytics, Remote Config, Crashlytics), screens (ScreenUtils) and Base > Hub. Optional SDKs switch their part off when missing.

samples.description: The UI and GameState flow of a casual game without gameplay, in scene 99_SampleScene: home, in-game screen, result, revive, pause, settings, shop (IAP packs), daily login, missions and achievements, the Game Flow test panel (Casual / Racing results). Needs the Splash from Base > Hub > Setup. Read its README.md.
Game data on Base: item catalogues (characters, vehicles), the game's own save sections, a legacy save migration and a custom popup, in scene 98_DataSample. Needs the Splash from Base > Hub > Setup.
